tournaments.title: SOLO CLUTCHER
tournaments.description:
Welcome to the NexusX Esports India - SOLO CLUTCHER Showdown! Register for free, showcase your solo survival skills, and win instant cash prizes.

🏆 PRIZE POOL BREAKDOWN (Total ₹100):
• 1st Place: ₹50
• 2nd Place: ₹30
• 3rd Place: ₹20

⚠️ TOURNAMENT RULES:
• Mobile Devices Only (Emulators & iPads are strictly banned).
• Minimum BGMI Account Level: 30+.
• Zero tolerance for hacking, GFX tools, or teaming up in Solo mode.
• Room ID & Password will be shared 10 minutes before the match on our official WhatsApp Group & Discord Server.
• Top 3 winners must submit their match result screenshot to claim prizes.
